**State Management:**

**Performance:**

tasks.title: Implement Client-Facing Document Upload with IndexedDB Persistence
tasks.description: Build robust file upload system that allows clients to upload documents from portal with offline draft support and progress tracking
tasks.details:
**Upload Flow:**

1. **Client Portal UI:**
   - PIECES checklist showing required documents
   - Each uncompleted piece shows "Upload" button
   - Drag-and-drop zone for files
   - File type validation (PDF, DOCX, JPG, PNG)
   - File size limit (10MB per file)
   - Progress bar during upload
   - Success/error toast notifications

2. **IndexedDB Draft Storage:**
   - Before upload to Firebase, save file + metadata to IndexedDB
   - Schema: `{ pieceKey, fileName, fileBlob, timestamp, uploaded: false }`
   - Allows client to save progress offline
   - "Pending Uploads" section shows drafts
   - Auto-upload when connection restored

3. **Firebase Storage Upload:**
   ```typescript
   const storagePath = `clients/${userId}/files/${fileId}/${pieceKey}/${fileName}`;
   const { url } = await uploadFile(storagePath, file);
   await patchDoc('clientFiles', fileId, {
     [`pieces.${pieceKey}.uploaded`]: true,
     [`pieces.${pieceKey}.fileURL`]: url,
     [`pieces.${pieceKey}.uploadedAt`]: serverTimestamp()
   });
   ```

4. **Firestore Metadata Update:**
   - Create document in `clientDocuments` collection
   - Update `clientFiles/{fileId}` with piece completion
   - Trigger notification to admin (add to `notifications` collection)

5. **Security:**
   - Firestore rules: clients can only upload to their own fileId
   - Storage rules: validate file extension and size server-side
   - Sanitize file names (remove special chars)

6. **Error Handling:**
   - Network error → save to IndexedDB, show "Will retry"
   - File too large → show error, suggest compression
   - Invalid type → show allowed types
   - Storage quota exceeded → notify admin

**Components:**
- `components/ClientPortal/FileUploader.tsx` - main upload widget
- `hooks/useIndexedDB.ts` - IndexedDB persistence layer
- `hooks/useFileUpload.ts` - upload logic with retry

**IndexedDB Schema:**
```typescript
interface DraftUpload {
  id: string;
  fileId: string;
  pieceKey: string;
  fileName: string;
  fileBlob: Blob;
  timestamp: number;
  uploaded: boolean;
  error?: string;
}
```
tasks.testStrategy: Test upload flow end-to-end (select file → upload → verify in Firestore + Storage). Simulate offline mode and verify draft saves to IndexedDB. Reconnect and confirm auto-upload triggers. Test file validation (wrong type, too large). Verify security rules block unauthorized uploads. Test concurrent uploads of multiple files. Performance test with 10 files uploaded simultaneously.

tasks.title: Build Real-Time Messaging System Between Clients and Admin
tasks.description: Implement threaded messaging component allowing clients and Laurie to communicate within each client file context
tasks.details:
**Architecture:**

1. **Firestore Structure:**
   ```
   clientMessages/{messageId}
   {
     fileId: string,
     senderId: string,
     senderRole: 'client' | 'admin',
     senderName: string,
     body: string,
     createdAt: Timestamp,
     read: boolean
   }
   ```

2. **Client Portal Component:**
   - `components/ClientPortal/MessageThread.tsx`
   - List all messages for current fileId (ordered by createdAt desc)
   - Input field for new messages
   - Auto-scroll to latest message
   - Visual distinction between sent/received messages
   - "Laurie is typing..." indicator (optional)
   - Unread message count badge

3. **Admin Component:**
   - Same `MessageThread` component reused
   - Integrated into `AdminClientFiles` detail view
   - Desktop notification when new message arrives
   - Mark messages as read when viewed

4. **Real-Time Subscription:**
   ```typescript
   const { data: messages } = useCollection<ClientMessage>(
     'clientMessages',
     [where('fileId', '==', currentFileId), orderBy('createdAt', 'desc')]
   );
   ```

5. **Send Message:**
   ```typescript
   const sendMessage = async (body: string) => {
     await createDoc('clientMessages', {
       fileId: currentFileId,
       senderId: currentUser.uid,
       senderRole: userIsAdmin ? 'admin' : 'client',
       senderName: currentUser.displayName,
       body,
       read: false
     });
   };
   ```

6. **Notification System:**
   - When client sends message, create unread indicator for admin
   - When admin sends message, trigger email notification to client (optional)
   - Mark as read when message enters viewport (Intersection Observer)

7. **Polish:**
   - Markdown support in messages (basic: **bold**, *italic*, links)
   - File attachment support (upload to Storage, embed link in message)
   - Timestamp formatting ("Just now", "5 min ago", "Jan 15, 3:42 PM")
   - Message editing (within 5 min of sending)
   - Message reactions (optional: 👍 ✅ ❤️)

**UI Design:**
- Chat bubble design (client: cyan accent, admin: slate)
- Avatar icons (user photo or initials)
- Timestamp on hover
- Loading skeleton during fetch
- Empty state: "No messages yet. Start the conversation!"

**Performance:**
- Virtualized list for threads with >50 messages
- Paginate messages (load 20 at a time, "Load more" button)
- Debounce typing indicator
tasks.testStrategy: Test real-time message delivery (open client + admin in separate browsers, send from each). Verify unread count updates correctly. Test mark-as-read functionality. Validate message ordering (newest first). Test with 100+ messages (performance). Verify file attachments upload and display. Test markdown rendering. Simulate network latency and verify optimistic UI updates.

tasks.title: Visual Validation and Design System Alignment
tasks.description: Audit all new client portal pages against Xena Horizon design system, capture screenshots, and refine styling to match premium glassmorphism aesthetic
tasks.details:
**Design System Audit:**

1. **Extract Current Design Tokens:**
   - Review `constants.tsx` for brand colors, typography, spacing
   - Document color palette:
     - Primary: cyan-400/500
     - Background: slate-950
     - Glass: black/40 + backdrop-blur-md
     - Border: white/15
     - Text: slate-100
   - Typography stack: check existing pages for font families
   - Border radius: ~15px (RÈGLE CANON DU CLIENT)

2. **Apply Glassmorphism to Client Portal:**
   - All cards: `bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/15 rounded-[15px]`
   - Buttons: Primary (cyan-400 with glow), Secondary (glass with border)
   - Inputs: Glass background with white/20 border, focus glow
   - Modals: Glass overlay + glass card

3. **Typography Hierarchy:**
   - Headings: Large, medium weight, cyan accent color
   - Body: Regular weight, slate-100
   - Max 2 lines for section titles (RÈGLE TYPO ABSOLUE)
   - No italics (RÈGLE VISUEL D'ABORD point 6)

4. **Component Consistency:**
   - Reuse existing `GlassCard` component where applicable
   - Extract common button styles to shared component
   - Ensure all icons use lucide-react (consistent with existing pages)

5. **Visual Captures:**
   - Use Playwright to capture screenshots:
     - Desktop (1440px): All client portal pages + admin pages
     - Mobile (390px): Same pages, verify responsive layout
   - Capture scroll positions showing:
     - Hero/header
     - Main content area
     - Footer
   - Save to `screenshots/` folder with descriptive names

6. **Boucle de Vérification (RÈGLE -5):**
   - Review each screenshot against checklist:
     - ✓ Full width usage (no centered block with side gaps)
     - ✓ No overlapping elements (badges hiding text)
     - ✓ Titles max 2 lines
     - ✓ Embedded content (no buttons opening new tabs)
     - ✓ Sticky sections where appropriate
     - ✓ Text readable on all backgrounds
   - Run independent verifier agent if needed
   - Max 3 iteration rounds, document any remaining issues

7. **Motion/Animation:**
   - Add subtle transitions to interactive elements:
     - Hover states: scale(1.02) + glow increase
     - Modal open/close: fade + scale spring animation
     - Page transitions: fade in on route change
   - Use framer-motion for complex animations
   - Respect reduced-motion preferences

8. **Polish Pass:**
   - Loading states for all async operations
   - Empty states with helpful messaging + illustration
   - Error states with clear recovery actions
   - Success feedback (toasts, check marks, etc.)
   - Skeleton loaders during data fetch

**Files to Review:**
- `pages/ClientPortal.tsx`
- `pages/AdminClientFiles.tsx`
- All `components/ClientPortal/*`
- All `components/AdminClientFiles/*`

**Comparison Benchmarks:**
- Reference: Existing `pages/PublicHome.tsx`, `pages/AdminDashboard.tsx`
- Bar: "Does this beat Google AI Studio?" (RÈGLE VISUEL D'ABORD)

**Documentation:**
- Create `docs/DESIGN_TOKENS.md` with all finalized tokens
- Screenshot grid in `docs/VISUAL_AUDIT.md` with pass/fail notes
tasks.testStrategy: Capture screenshots at 1440px and 390px for all pages. Run visual regression against reference pages (PublicHome, AdminDashboard). Verify all design tokens are consistently applied (grep for hardcoded colors). Test all interactive states (hover, focus, active, disabled). Validate motion respects prefers-reduced-motion. Confirm empty and error states render correctly. Performance audit: Lighthouse score >90 for all pages.

tasks.title: Security Audit and Firestore Rules for Client Portal

tasks.testStrategy: Deploy rules to Firebase emulator. Run automated test suite covering all read/write scenarios. Manually test with two logged-in clients attempting to access each other's data. Verify admin can access everything. Test file upload with invalid types and oversized files. Check Firebase console audit logs for unauthorized access attempts. Perform security audit using Firebase Security Rules testing framework.

tasks.title: Deploy to Production and Final Integration Testing
tasks.description: Deploy all changes to Firebase Hosting, run end-to-end tests across all workflows, and verify production environment is stable and secure
tasks.details:
**Pre-Deployment Checklist:**

1. **Environment Configuration:**
   - Verify `.env.example` is up to date
   - Confirm production Firebase project (xena-70977) config in `.env.local`
   - Check all API keys are in environment variables (no hardcoded secrets)
   - Verify Firebase project has billing enabled (for Storage usage)

2. **Build Verification:**
   ```bash
   npm run build
   ```
   - Confirm build completes without errors
   - Check bundle size (should be <500KB gzipped)
   - Verify no console errors in production build
   - Test production build locally: `npm run preview`

3. **Code Quality:**
   - Run linter: `npm run lint` (if configured)
   - Fix any TypeScript errors
   - Remove all console.logs and debug code
   - Remove any TODOs or commented code
   - Verify no reference project names remain (grep for "dufresne", "bdt")

4. **Firebase Deployment:**
   ```bash
   firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules,storage:rules,firestore:indexes
   ```
   - Deploy to xenahorizon.com (or configured domain)
   - Verify DNS records point to Firebase Hosting
   - Enable SSL certificate
   - Configure redirects if needed

5. **Database Initialization:**
   - Create initial admin user in `admins` collection
   - Verify `settings/homeBlocks` exists with production content
   - Seed initial products if needed
   - Create test client portal user for QA

**End-to-End Testing:**

1. **Public Site:**
   - [ ] Home page loads correctly
   - [ ] Services page displays all three archetypes
   - [ ] Navigation works (all links)
   - [ ] Contact form submits to Firestore (creates lead)
   - [ ] Language toggle works (FR/EN)
   - [ ] Mobile responsive (test on real device)
   - [ ] SEO meta tags present (view source)

2. **Admin Authentication:**
   - [ ] Admin login with Google OAuth works
   - [ ] Non-admin user cannot access admin routes
   - [ ] Admin can access all admin pages
   - [ ] Sign out works correctly

3. **Client Portal (End-to-End):**
   - [ ] Client can sign up with email
   - [ ] Client can sign in with Google
   - [ ] Profile creation flow works
   - [ ] Client sees their file dashboard
   - [ ] Client can upload document (test with PDF)
   - [ ] Uploaded document appears in Firestore + Storage
   - [ ] Client can send message
   - [ ] Client sees admin reply in real-time

4. **Admin Back-Office:**
   - [ ] Admin sees all client files
   - [ ] Admin can filter by status/archetype
   - [ ] Admin can open file detail view
   - [ ] Admin can download uploaded documents
   - [ ] Admin can update file status/stage
   - [ ] Admin can add notes (auto-save works)
   - [ ] Admin can send message to client
   - [ ] Admin can export file to Markdown
   - [ ] Admin can export file to PDF

5. **Performance Testing:**
   - Run Lighthouse audit (target: >90 for all metrics)
   - Test with slow 3G throttling
   - Verify images are optimized
   - Check Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS)
   - Monitor Firebase quota usage

6. **Security Validation:**
   - Attempt to access other user's data (should fail)
   - Test SQL injection in text inputs (should be sanitized)
   - Verify no secrets in client-side code (check Network tab)
   - Test CORS for Firebase Storage
   - Verify Content Security Policy headers

7. **Cross-Browser Testing:**
   - Chrome (latest)
   - Firefox (latest)
   - Safari (latest)
   - Mobile Safari (iOS)
   - Chrome Mobile (Android)

**Post-Deployment:**

1. **Monitoring Setup:**
   - Enable Firebase Analytics
   - Set up error tracking (Firebase Crashlytics or Sentry)
   - Configure uptime monitoring
   - Set up alerts for quota limits

2. **Documentation:**
   - Update README.md with production URL
   - Document admin login process
   - Create user guide for Laurie (how to manage clients)
   - Document backup/restore procedures

3. **Handoff:**
   - Schedule walkthrough with Laurie
   - Provide admin credentials
   - Share documentation links
   - Set up support channel

**Rollback Plan:**
- Previous deployment ID: document before deploying
- Rollback command: `firebase hosting:rollback`
- Database restore: use Firestore backup (if enabled)

**Success Criteria:**
- All public pages load <2s on 3G
- Zero console errors in production
- All end-to-end tests pass
- Lighthouse score >90
- Security rules block unauthorized access
- Admin can manage minimum 10 test client files without performance degradation
tasks.testStrategy: Execute full checklist above. Document any failures with screenshots and reproduction steps. Run load test with 50 concurrent users. Verify Firebase quotas are not exceeded. Test disaster recovery (backup restore). Confirm SSL certificate is valid. Validate all forms submit correctly. Test email notifications (if implemented). Monitor for 24 hours post-deployment and check error logs.
